metaDescription: Meet Alethig Media, a digital marketing agency based in Long Island, founded by an immigrant. We work with businesses in Long Island and beyond. Bilingual in English and Spanish.
heroHeading: We're From Here. We Grow Businesses Here.
heroParagraph: Alethig Media is a digital marketing agency based in Long Island, founded by an immigrant, for the community.

aboutImageAlt: Alexis Fuel, founder of Alethig Media, with Gisella and Thiago
aboutParagraphs: Alethig Media was founded by Alexis Fuel, an Ecuadorian immigrant who built his sales and marketing career in Long Island, New York.

After years in the corporate world, watching local businesses struggle to build a real online presence — barbershops, restaurants, contractors, salons — he decided it was time to do something about it.
He launched Alethig Media with a simple mission: give Long Island businesses the same professional digital marketing that big companies have, at a price that makes sense for small business owners.

The name Alethig is personal: it combines the names of the three most important people in his life — Alexis, Thiago (his son), and Gisella (his wife). Every client we serve is part of that same story: building something real, for the people we love.

statsParagraph: Our mission: help businesses grow online with honest, transparent, results-focused digital marketing — starting right here in Long Island — in English and in Spanish.

stats.label: No hidden fees, no confusing reports. You always know what we're doing and why.
We live in Long Island, and we work with businesses beyond it too. Your success is our success.
We don't measure in likes. We measure in leads, calls, and new customers.
English and Spanish. Because Long Island is both, and so are we.
